original: prāṇagateśca prāṇānām – indriyāṇām, gateśva - ' prāṇo'nūtkrāmati iti gacchatā jīvena saha gamanaśruterapi jñāpakāt jīvaḥ sampariṣvaktaḥ dehatā māpannaiḥ bhūtasūkṣmaiḥ saṃśliṣṭa eva san, raṃhati dehāddehāntaraṃ gacchati ||
analyzed: prāṇa gateḥ ca prāṇānām indriyāṇām gateḥ ca prāṇaḥ unūtkrāmati iti gacchatā jīvena saha gamana śruteḥ api jñāpakāt jīvaḥ sampariṣvaktaḥ deha tā mā āpannaiḥ bhūta sūkṣmaiḥ saṃśliṣṭaḥ eva san raṃhati dehāt deha antaram gacchati

original: 291. agnyādigatiśruteriti cenna ; bhāktatvāt agnyādigatiśruteḥ- vāgādirūpāṇāmindriyāṇām agnyādiṣu apyayasya agniṃ vāgapyeti' ityādiṣu śravaṇāt, prāṇagatiḥ indriyāṇāṃ jīvena sākaṃ gamanaśrutiḥ (na mukhyā ; kintu anyathā neyā) iti cet - evaṃ kathanaṃ tu, na—na yuktam, bhāktatvāt - vāgādiśabdānāṃ vāgādyabhimānidevatāsu upacārata: prayuktatvāt ||
analyzed: agni ādi gati śruteḥ iti ced na bhākta tvāt agni ādi gati śruteḥ vāc ādi rūpāṇām indriyāṇām agni ādiṣu apyayasya agnim vāc apyeti ityādiṣu śravaṇāt prāṇa gatiḥ indriyāṇām jīvena sākam gamana śrutiḥ na mukhyā kintu anyathā neyā iti ced evam kathanam tu yuktam bhākta tvāt vāc ādi śabdānām vāc ādi abhimāni devatāsu upacārāt prayukta tvāt

original: 292 prathame'śravaṇāditi cenna ; tā eva hyupapatte: prathame – pañcāgnividyāyāṃ dyulokātmakāmgnyadhikaraṇa ke home, aśravaṇāt - apāṃ homakarmatvena śrutau apaṭhanāt ( āpa: bhūtaḥ ntarasaṃsṛṣṭatayā gacchanti ityetat na suvacam ) iti cenna - idaṃ kathanaṃ na yuktam, hi yataḥ, tā eva - āpa eva (dhulokā nihomyaśraddhāpadenocyante) ;
analyzed: prathame śravaṇāt iti ced na tāḥ eva hi upapatte prathame pañcāgni vidyāyām home aśravaṇāt apām homa karma tvena śrutau apaṭhanāt āpa bhūtaḥ antara saṃsṛṣṭa tayā gacchanti iti etat na suvacam iti ced na idam kathanam na yuktam hi yatas tāḥ eva apaḥ eva nihomya śraddhā padena ucyante

original: upapatteḥ prativacane praśnānuguṇyasya tathā satyeva upapādanīyatvāt ||
analyzed: upapatteḥ prativacane praśna ānuguṇyasya tathā sati eva upapādanīya tvāt

original: 293. aśrutatvāditi cennaḥ ; iṣṭādikāriṇāṃ pratīte: aśrutatvāt- (apāmeva gamanaśrutyā) adbhiḥ saṃpariṣvaktajīvagamanasya śrutau apaṭhitatvāt, (jīvo gacchatīti durvacam ) iti cet na – evaṃ kathanaṃ na saṅgacchate, iṣṭādikāriṇām – yāgadānādikāmya- karmakṛtāṃ jīvānām, pratīteḥ - vākye pratyabhijñānāt, 'ap'śabdaḥ apsaṃyukta jīvavācyeva ;
analyzed: aśruta tvāt iti ced naḥ iṣṭa ādi kāriṇām pratīte aśruta tvāt apām eva gamana śrutyāḥ adbhiḥ saṃpariṣvakta jīva gamanasya śrutau apaṭhita tvāt jīvaḥ gacchati iti durvacam iti ced na evam kathanam na saṅgacchate iṣṭa ādi kāriṇām yāga dāna ādi kāmya karma kṛtām jīvānām pratīteḥ vākye pratyabhijñānāt ap śabdaḥ ap saṃyukta jīva vācī eva

original: 294. bhāktaṃ vā'nātmavittvāttathā hi darśayati – ('taṃ devā bhakṣayanti' iti, dhūmapathena gatasya devaiḥ bhakṣyatvavacanaṃ ) bhāktaṃ vā aupacārikameva, (devopakaraṇatvābhiprāyameva), anātmavittvāt – (paramapurudhārādhanaveṣatāṃ vinā kevaleṣṭā dikāriṇām ) ātmaveditvābhāvāt tathā hi darśayati śrutiḥ ( ' yathā paśuḥ evaṃ sa devānām ' ) iti
analyzed: bhāktam vā an ātma vid tvāt tathā hi darśayati tam devāḥ bhakṣayanti iti dhūma pathena gatasya devaiḥ bhakṣya tva vacanam bhāktam vā aupacārikam eva deva upakaraṇa tva abhiprāyam eva anātma vid tvāt parama puru dhārā dhana veṣa tām vinā kevala iṣṭā ātma vedi tva abhāvāt tathā hi darśayati śrutiḥ yathā paśuḥ evam sa devānām iti

original: kṛtātyayādhikaraṇam 295. kṛtātyaye'nuśayavān dṛṣṭa-smṛtibhyāṃ yathetamanetraṃ ca kṛtātyaye-
analyzed: kṛta atyaya adhikaraṇam kṛta atyaya inuśayavān dṛṣṭa smṛtibhyām yathetam anetram ca kṛta atyaye

original: pūrvakarmaṇāṃ bhogena vināśe sati, anuśayavān bhuktaśiṣṭa karmavān cetanaḥ yathetam - ārohaṇaprakāreṇa, anevaṃ ca prakārāntareṇa ca (svargāde: nivartate iti) dṛṣṭa-smṛtibhyām - śruti smṛtibhyāmavagamyate ||
analyzed: pūrva karmaṇām bhogena vināśe sati anuśayavān bhukta śiṣṭa karmavān cetanaḥ yathetam ārohaṇa prakāreṇa anevam ca prakāra antareṇa ca svarga āde nivartate iti dṛṣṭa smṛtibhyām śruti smṛtibhyām avagamyate

original: 296. caraṇāditi cenna tadupalakṣaṇārtheti kārṣṇājini: caraṇāt- śīlācārādinaiva, ( ramaṇīyādiyoniviśeṣaprāptiḥ ; na tu anuśayāt bhuktaśiṣṭāt karmaṇaḥ) iticet — evaṃ kathanaṃ tu, na-na yuktam, tadupalakṣaṇārtheti - ' ramaṇīyacaraṇā:' iti śrutiḥ) puṇya-pāpātmakakarmajñāpanārthaṃ pravṛtteti, kāṣrṇājiniḥ kāṣrṇājinināmā ācāryo manyate ||
analyzed: caraṇāt iti ced na tad upalakṣaṇa arthā iti kārṣṇājini caraṇāt śīla ācāra ādinā eva ramaṇīya ādi yoni viśeṣa prāptiḥ na tu anuśayāt bhukta śiṣṭāt karmaṇaḥ iti ced evam kathanam tu yuktam tad upalakṣaṇa arthā iti ramaṇīya caraṇāḥ iti śrutiḥ puṇya pāpa ātmaka karma jñāpana artham pravṛttā iti kāṣrṇājiniḥ kāṣrṇājini nāmā ācāryaḥ manyate

original: 297. ānarthakyamiti cenna tadapekṣatvāt ānarthakyam – (yoni viśeṣa- prāptau puṇyāpuṇyoreva prayojakatve ) sadācāranai phalyam iti cet — evaṃ śaṅkanaṃ tu, na nocitam tadapekṣatvāt – puṇyātmakānāṃ karmaṇāṃ sadācārasāpekṣatvāt, (na ācārānarthakyam ) || 298.
analyzed: ānarthakyam iti ced na tad apekṣa tvāt ānarthakyam yoni viśeṣa prāptau puṇya apuṇyoḥ eva prayojaka tve sat ācāra naiphalyam iti ced evam śaṅkanam tu na na ucitam tad apekṣa tvāt puṇya ātmakānām karmaṇām sat ācāra sāpekṣa tvāt na ācāra ānarthakyam

original: sukṛtaduṣkṛte eveti tu bādariḥ sukṛta- duṣkṛte eva - puṇya pāpe eva ' caraṇa 'śabdābhidheye, iti tu ityeva, bādariḥ - bādarināmā ācāryo manyate ||
analyzed: sukṛta duṣkṛte eva iti tu bādariḥ sukṛta duṣkṛte eva puṇya pāpe eva caraṇa śabda abhidheye iti tu iti eva bādariḥ bādari nāmā ācāryaḥ manyate

original: aniṣṭādikāriṇāmapi ca śrutam aniṣṭādikāriṇāmapi - iṣṭāpūrtadi akurva pāpināmapi śrutaṃ ca - ( ' candramasameva te sarve gacchanti' iti ) candragamanameva śrutau bodhitam |
analyzed: aniṣṭa ādi kāriṇām api ca śrutam aniṣṭa ādi kāriṇām api iṣṭāpūrta di akurva pāpinām api śrutam ca candramasam eva te sarve gacchanti iti candra gamanam eva śrutau bodhitam

original: 300. saṃyamane tvanubhūyārohavarohau tadgatidarśanāt ārohāvarohau - ( aniṣṭādikāriṇāṃ pāpināṃ ) candrāroha: tasmādavarohaśca, saṃyamane—yamaśāsanaviṣaye pradeśe, anubhūya tu — pāpaphala saṃvedanaṃ prāpyaiva bhavati, tadgatidarśanāt - yamasadanaṃ prati gateḥ (vaivasvataṃ saṅgamanaṃ janānām ) iti śrutyā pratipatteḥ ||
analyzed: saṃyamane tu anubhūya āroha varohau tad gati darśanāt āroha avarohau aniṣṭa ādi kāriṇām pāpinām candrāroha tasmāt avarohaḥ ca saṃyamana iyama śāsana viṣaye pradeśe anubhūya tu pāpa phala saṃvedanam prāpya eva bhavati tad gati darśanāt yama sadanam prati gateḥ vaivasvatam saṅgamanam janānām iti śrutyā pratipatteḥ

original: 301 smaranti ca smaranti ca parāśarādayo maharṣayaḥ ' sarve caite vaśa - yānti yamasya ' iti yamasadanaprāpti smṛtau bodhayanti ||
analyzed: smaranti ca smaranti ca parāśara ādayaḥ mahā ṛṣayaḥ sarve ca ete yānti yamasya iti yama sadana prāpti smṛtau bodhayanti

original: 302. api sapta saptā'pi - rauravādīn sapta narakānapi smaranti pāpināṃ gantavyatayā munayaḥ smṛtiṣu bodhayanti ||
analyzed: api sapta sapta api raurava ādīn sapta narakān api smaranti pāpinām gantavya tayā munayaḥ smṛtiṣu bodhayanti

original: 303. tatrā'pi tavyāpārādavirodhaḥ tatrā'pi - rauravādiṣu narakākhyeṣu saptaṣu lokeṣvapi tadvyāpārāt - yamājñayaiva gamanāt, avirodhaḥ - yamasadanaprāptibodhakavākya- virodho nā'sti ||
analyzed: tatra api tad vyāpārāt avirodhaḥ tatra api raurava ādiṣu naraka ākhyeṣu saptaṣu lokeṣu api tad vyāpārāt yama ājñayā eva gamanāt avirodhaḥ yama sadana prāpti bodhaka vākya virodhaḥ na asti

original: 304. vidyā - karmaṇoriti tu prakṛtatvāt vidyākarmaṇoḥ arcirādinā brahmagamanasya, vidyāyāḥ phalatvāt dhūmādinā candragamanasya ca iṣṭāpūrtādikarmaṇa: phalatvāt, ( tatphalatvaṃ ca ) iti prakṛtatvāt - itthaṃ vidyā- karmaṇī prakṛtya pratipāditatvāt (vidyā- karmarahitānāṃ pāpināṃ brahmagamanasya candragamanasya cā'sambhavaḥ iti jñāyate ) ||
analyzed: vidyā karmaṇoḥ iti tu prakṛta tvāt vidyā karmaṇoḥ arciḥ ādinā brahma gamanasya vidyāyāḥ phala tvāt dhūma ādinā candra gamanasya ca iṣṭāpūrta ādi karmaṇaḥ phala tvāt tad phala tvam ca iti prakṛta tvāt ittham vidyā karmaṇī prakṛtya pratipādita tvāt vidyā karma rahitānām pāpinām brahma gamanasya candra gamanasya ca asambhavaḥ iti jñāyate

original: 305. na tṛtīye tathopalabdheḥ tṛtīye - tṛtīyasthānasaṃjñakānāṃ pāpakarmiṇa dehārambhe, pañcamātyapekṣā na vidyate, tathā - pañcamā hutyanapekṣatvena, upalabdheḥ - ' tenā'sau loko na sampūryate ' iti śrutau darśanāt ||
analyzed: na tṛtīye tathā upalabdheḥ tṛtīye tṛtīya sthāna saṃjñakānām pāpa karmiṇaḥ deha ārambhe pañcamā atyapekṣā na vidyate tathā pañcamā āhuti anapekṣa tvena upalabdheḥ tena asau lokaḥ na sampūryate iti śrutau darśanāt

original: 306. smaryate'pi ca loke loke'pi - śiṣṭaloke'pi, smaryate ca- draupadyādīnāṃ puṇyakarmiṇāṃ dehārambhe pañcamāhuteranapekṣā mahābhāratādau smaryata eva ||
analyzed: smaryate api ca loke loke api śiṣṭa loke api smaryate ca draupadī ādīnām puṇya karmiṇām deha ārambhe pañcama āhuteḥ anapekṣā mahābhārata ādau smaryate eva

original: 307. darśanācca ( svedajodbhijjayoḥ dehārambhe pañcamā hutyanapekṣāyāḥ) darśanācca- ' trīṇyeva bījāni bhavanti āṇḍajaṃ jīvajamudbhijjam' iti śrutau paṭhanādapi jñāpakāt ||
analyzed: darśanāt ca sveda ja udbhid jayoḥ deha ārambhe pañcamā āhuti anapekṣāyāḥ darśanāt ca trīṇi eva bījāni bhavanti āṇḍa jam jīva jam udbhijjam iti śrutau paṭhanāt api jñāpakāt

original: 308. tṛtīyaśabdāvarodhaḥ saṃśokajasya saṃśokajasya - svedajasya, tṛtīya- śabdena - udbhijjaśabdena, avarodhaḥ – saṃgraho bhavati ataḥ svedajo'pi śrutipaṭhita eva, ( tasmāt kevala pāpināṃ na candrārohāvaroha sambhavataḥ ) ||
analyzed: tṛtīya śabda avarodhaḥ saṃśoka jasya saṃśoka jasya sveda jasya tṛtīya śabdena udbhijja śabdena avarodhaḥ saṃgrahaḥ bhavati atas sveda jaḥ api śruti paṭhitaḥ eva tasmāt kevala pāpinām na candrāroha avaroha sambhavataḥ

original: vrīhyādiśarīre, (avarohatāṃ jīvānāṃ saṃśleṣamātrameva ) pūrvavat - ākāśādimeghaparyantavat, abhilāpāt— kevalatadbhāvasyaiva śrutau kathanāt, (bhogakāraṇībhūtakarmākathanāt trīhyādiśarīrā- vacchinnabhogo nāsti ityarthaḥ) ||
analyzed: vrīhi ādi śarīre avarohatām jīvānām saṃśleṣa mātram eva pūrvavat ākāśa ādi megha paryanta vat abhilāpāt kevala tad bhāvasya eva śrutau kathanāt bhoga kāraṇībhūta karma a kathanāt trīhi ādi śarīra avacchinna bhogaḥ na asti iti arthaḥ

original: 312. aśuddhamiti cenna śabdāt aśuddham – ( yāgādijanyaṃ svargādikaṃ phalam - paśuhiṃsājanyatvāt ) aśuddhimiśram, (tena trīhyādyaśuci janma heturbhavati) iti cet- evaṃ śaṅkanam na na saṅgatam, śabdāt - hiṃsātvābhāvabodhakāt ' na vā u vetantriya se na riṣyasi ' ityevamādeḥ śrautāt śabdāt ||
analyzed: aśuddham iti ced na śabdāt aśuddham yāga ādi janyam svarga ādikam phalam paśu hiṃsā janya tvāt aśuddhi miśram tena trīhi ādi aśuci janma hetuḥ bhavati iti ced evam śaṅkanam na na saṅgatam śabdāt hiṃsā tva abhāva bodhakāt na vā u na riṣyasi iti evamādeḥ śrautāt śabdāt

original: 313. retassigyogo'tha atha - - tadanantarabhāvī, retassimyogaḥ - avarohatāṃ jīvānām annena saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ retassigbhiḥ dehibhiḥ saha uktaḥ sambandhaḥ, yathā kevalaṃ yogamātraṃ, tatha vrīhyādiyogo'pi sambamdhamātrameva ||
analyzed: atha tad anantara bhāvī retassimyogaḥ atha tad anantara bhāvī avarohatām jīvānām annena saṃsṛṣṭānām retassigbhiḥ dehibhiḥ saha uktaḥ sambandhaḥ yathā kevalam yoga mātram vrīhi ādi yogaḥ api sambamdha mātram eva

original: 314. yoneḥ śarīram yone: - avarohato jīvasya yoniprāpteranantarameva, śarīram - śarīravattā bhavati; na tu tataḥ prākū ||
analyzed: yoneḥ śarīram yone avarohataḥ jīvasya yoni prāpteḥ anantaram eva śarīram śarīravat tā bhavati na tu tatas prākū

original: 318. parābhidhyānātu tirohitaṃ tato hyasya bandhaviparyayau || parābhidhyānātu- paramapuruṣa saṅkalpādeva, asya jīvasya svābhāvikaṃ rūpam, tirohitam – anādikarmapravāheṇa sāparādhatayā ācchāditam, tato hi paramapuruṣasaṅkalpādeva hi, asya jīvasya, bandhaviparyayau – saṃsārāpavargoṃ śrutau yete ||
analyzed: tirohitam tatas hi asya bandha viparyayau para abhidhyānātu paramapuruṣa saṅkalpāt eva asya jīvasya svābhāvikam rūpam tirohitam anādi karma pravāheṇa sa aparādha tayā ācchāditam tatas hi paramapuruṣa saṅkalpāt eva hi asya jīvasya bandha viparyayau saṃsāra apavargau śrutau

original: 319. dehayogādvā so'pi so'pi - jīvātmanaḥ tirodhānasambandho'pi dehasya - devādyākārapariṇatasyā'citaḥ, (tathā) nāma-rūpavibhāgānarhasūkṣmadaśāpannasyā'citaśca yogāt- (sṛṣṭi-pralayakālikāt ) saṃsargāt bhavati ||
analyzed: deha yogāt vā saḥ api saḥ api jīvātmanaḥ tirodhāna sambandhaḥ api dehasya deva ādi ākāra pariṇatasya ācitaḥ tathā nāma rūpa vibhāga anarha sūkṣma daśā āpannasya ācitaḥ ca yogāt sṛṣṭi pralaya kālikāt saṃsargāt bhavati

original: sūcakaśca hi śruterācakṣate ca tadvidaḥ hi – yataḥ sandhyam - sandhyapadavācyaḥ svapnaḥ, sūcakaścana kevalaṃ puruṣaviśeṣasya anubhava viṣayaḥ, bhāvinoḥ śubhāśubhayoḥ arthayoḥ sūcako'pi iti śruteḥ – 'striyaṃ svapneṣu paśyati | samṛddhiṃ tatra tadvidaśva – svapnādhyāyavido'pi, ācakṣate - enamevārtha
analyzed: sūcakaḥ ca hi śruteḥ ācakṣate ca tad vidaḥ hi yatas sandhyam sandhya pada vācyaḥ svapnaḥ sūcakaḥ cana kevalam puruṣa viśeṣasya anubhava viṣayaḥ bhāvinoḥ śubha aśubhayoḥ arthayoḥ sūcakaḥ api iti śruteḥ striyam svapneṣu paśyati samṛddhim tatra svapnādhyāya vidaḥ api ācakṣate enam eva artha
vadanti īśvarasya eva svāpna artha sraṣṭṛ tve eva idam sarvam upapadyate

original: 324. mugdhe'rdhasampattiḥ pariśeṣāt mugdhe - mūrcchite puruṣe vidyamānā avasthā ardha sampattiḥ – ardhamṛtireva, pariśeṣāt - jāgrat - svapna suṣupti-maraṇātmakāvasthā bhinnāvasthāviśeṣa- rūpatvāt ||
analyzed: pariśeṣāt mugdha ṛdha sampattiḥ pariśeṣāt mugdhe mūrcchite puruṣe vidyamānā avasthā ardha sampattiḥ ardhamṛtiḥ eva pariśeṣāt jāgrat svapna suṣupti maraṇa ātmaka avasthā bhinna avasthā viśeṣa rūpa tvāt
